capabilities: , Scans notes for external media URLs
Rewrites note links to new locations
Stores files locally, on WebDAV, or S3
Filters media by host or size
problem: External media links referenced in notes can break or become inaccessible, and managing these files across different storage locations is cumbersome.
summary: Media Importer downloads remote media referenced in notes and stores it locally or on a remote backend like WebDAV or S3.
